scope: Proposed bounded semantic links; no global coverage binding or eligibility is activated.
claim_boundary: The passing named assertions and selected source precedence are the claim. Recipe count alone is not acceptance or exhaustive clause/interactions proof.
shared_limits: Controlled unit supplies, selected memory copies, HP/status/intent and protection fixtures isolate effects. This is not an earned campaign loadout or balance witness.
All successful Rules actions compare preview with exact committed state and ordered events. This does not prove disk persistence, UI input or presentation.
Only the explicit cross-recipe, robot-reaction and upgrade combinations named in each passing group are covered; no exhaustive interaction claim is made.
Physical lifecycle, cooldown availability and full-city route evidence remain separate. Registration or a physical output alone is not counted as this suite's semantic evidence.
